notes: The page opens section 1 of a handwritten-titled typescript on the theorem of Griffiths by an algebraic route. It assumes f:Y→S proper and smooth, inserts regularity of S, and works with a fixed prime represented by a chi-shaped glyph.
It calls a cohomology class primitive when its image in the indicated H^0 higher-direct-image group, equivalently in a geometric fibre, is zero. It then constructs u(x) in the (1,m-1) Leray term.

It introduces a correspondence class on Y x_S Y\prime, its induced degree-shifting cohomology map, a coefficient pairing, and the asserted compatibility u(Z(x\prime))=Z(u(x\prime)). The final sentence continues on another page, which was not inspected.

The source has NB as a literal parenthetical qualifier, but no explicit author question mark or verbal reservation on this page. Its phrase “évidemment” is transcribed as an assertion, not endorsed as a proof.
Mathematical diagnostic: the live L07 f-like coefficient is troublesome because F was the named sheaf; this prompted the one crop, but the ink still favours f with F retained as an alternative.

Mathematical diagnostic: the degree/twist relation is compatible with a 2d\prime shift, but the visible 2 and prime, not this calculation, decide the live correction. The original crossed capital X/Y remains unresolved.

All ordinary prose, accents, th., NB, lexical hyphens, primes, bar marks, punctuation and every display were read from the halves. No OCR, web, other page, other reader, or external restoration was used.

Handwritten attribution is descriptive only. Neither writer identity nor writing instrument is established by this image. Faint top-left edge traces outside the brown prefix have no safely identifiable textual reading and were treated as physical traces, not invented letters.
The LaTeX for the tensor sign uses only standard overlay commands to retain the typed x and handwritten circle separately. No new macro is defined.

check_events.outcome: Assuming the cohomological first-quadrant Leray spectral sequence and its filtration, a class in the kernel of the edge map lies in filtration F^1. Modulo F^2 it gives E_infinity^{1,m-1}. For r>=2, the potential incoming term has first index 1-r<0 and is zero, so E_infinity^{1,m-1} injects into E_2^{1,m-1}. This checks the formal shape of u(x), without proving specialization or any geometric theorem.

Assuming cup product with the correspondence raises cohomological degree by N and smooth proper pushforward along the Y\prime-factor lowers degree by 2d\prime and Tate twist by d\prime, the resulting degree is m\prime+N-2d\prime and the pairing F\prime tensor G→F(d\prime) yields final coefficient F. This is a consistency calculation only, not evidence restoring obscured ink.

brief_feedback: The packet refers to an attached PREAMBLE but does not give its path; only named brief macros and standard LaTeX commands were used. A policy distinguishing a chi-shaped machine substitute from its intended ell alphabet, and genuine double strike from merely heavy overprinting, would help keep diplomatic character choices consistent. Linearizing partially reused letters (the d in dim) also needs an explicit convention.
